broad that the player gets close to. Weigh the part count against

decision: In-game prop: a broken concrete wall with a round breach, for Snow Fortress; sibling of assets/models/brokenwall, same TRELLIS.2 generator and same treatment. Closed object with depth (relief 0.57), authored to be seen from any angle, so a mesh prop. Built by scene_kit at 20 studs long (about 15.5 tall, 11.5 deep), bottom pivot, decimated to 9,000 triangles in one mesh. The tile advice is overridden as for the helicopter and the other wall: a compact object seen from outside, and the breach and block courses survive at 9k (the brickwork is visibly faceted up close, accepted). Textures converted from 2048 WebP to 1024 PNG, base colour tinted (0.60, 0.58, 0.56, lift 0.03) so it does not vanish on snow. Placed as a Decor prop (fit/sit); scenery, not gameplay cover. Because the hole is see-through, it is a sightline and bullet gap only if made collidable, which is not planned.
